repoMeta.description: a local-first, deterministic repository health scanner that identifies actionable maintenance, documentation, configuration and CI problems without executing repository code or requiring external services.

AIIDE - An AI-powered web application designed to enhance developer productivity through intelligent code completion, error detection, and context-aware suggestions. Leveraging the power of large language models, this IDE aims to create an integrated environment that adapts to the user's coding style and project requirements.
